summaries.summary: The image illustrates 'The Publisher-Academic complex' with arrows showing funding and exchange relationships. Academia is funded by taxpayers, students, and researchers (in-kind), while publishers provide money and review services. The diagram references the 'Military-Industrial-Academic complex' from 1961, attributed to Dwight D Eisenhower.
key_facts: Academia is funded by taxpayers, students, and researchers (in-kind).
Publishers provide funding ($$) and review services ($$, MS review).
The diagram references the Military-Industrial-Academic complex (1961) by Dwight D Eisenhower.
